title.original: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
title.zh: SWE-bench：语言模型能否解决真实 GitHub 问题？
title.en: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?

inclusion_reason.zh: SWE-bench 将真实 issue、代码仓库、补丁执行和测试判定封装为可复现评测框架，是软件工程智能体生态的基础 Context。
inclusion_reason.en: SWE-bench packages real issues, repositories, patch execution, and test-based grading into a reproducible evaluation framework, making it foundational context for software-engineering agents.

abstract.zh: SWE-bench 从真实 GitHub issue 与对应 pull request 构建软件工程任务，要求模型阅读代码库并生成能通过执行验证的修改。
abstract.en: SWE-bench builds software-engineering tasks from real GitHub issues and corresponding pull requests, requiring models to inspect repositories and produce execution-validated changes.

problem.zh: 传统代码生成基准多为孤立函数，无法评估跨文件理解、长上下文、环境交互和真实维护问题的端到端解决能力。
problem.en: Traditional code-generation benchmarks use isolated functions and do not measure cross-file understanding, long context, environment interaction, or end-to-end maintenance.

approach.zh: 框架冻结问题描述和仓库版本，在隔离环境中应用模型补丁并运行测试，以真实修复是否成功作为可执行指标。
approach.en: The framework freezes an issue description and repository revision, applies model patches in an isolated environment, and runs tests to grade whether the real issue is resolved.

system_design.zh: 数据管线关联 issue、pull request 和仓库快照，任务运行器准备依赖并应用补丁，测试 harness 以回归与新增测试输出解决状态。
system_design.en: A data pipeline links issues, pull requests, and repository snapshots; a runner installs dependencies and applies patches, and a test harness reports resolution from regression and issue-specific tests.

key_results.zh: 摘要报告 Claude 2 是当时最佳模型但仅解决少量问题，说明真实仓库级软件工程明显超出传统生成任务。
key_results.en: The abstract reports Claude 2 as the strongest evaluated model while solving only a small fraction of issues, showing that repository-scale engineering is much harder than conventional generation.

limitations.zh: 任务受公开仓库、可重放依赖和测试质量限制；训练数据污染、环境漂移及测试不完备会影响分数解释。
limitations.en: Tasks are limited by public repositories, reproducible dependencies, and test quality; contamination, environment drift, and incomplete tests complicate score interpretation.

workloads: repository-level code editing and test execution

notes.zh: 模型、任务、硬件、基线与指标仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格和部署细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; undisclosed tables and deployment details still require full-text audit.
